census_excluded.reason: pack grammar defect (tree-sitter-language-pack 0.13.0): the `test` grammar parses the header (separator / name / separator) but its `input` region greedily consumes the closing separator line, so EVERY complete test record ends in a MISSING-separator error trait at EOF, and a header-only file is an outright ERROR node. F3 verified a matrix of real-syntax shapes (recorded below with their exact parse_diagnostics errors) — none parse clean, so no census fixture is fabricated. The F1 census correctly reported parse_degraded; the grammar itself is the problem
